title: BODYBUILDING + STRENGHT
author: Yaseen khan
desc:
This is the Block 1 (5 weeks long) of the PURE BODYBUILDING PROGRAM PHASE 1.

Week 6 has the 2nd Arms and Shoulder day for each week.

ex.note:
1 Warm up set 
1-8 Reps first working set 
12-15 Reps 2nd and 3rd set

1 Warm-up Set.

2-3 min Rest

Long-length Partials (on all reps of the last set)

8-10 then 4-6 Shrugs
squeeze your shoulder blades together hard at the top of each rep.Without resting, do another 4-6 reps as Kelso Shrugs (just squeeze your shoulder blades together without rowing

1 second pause at the bottom of each rep
8 Reps both sets
3-4 min Rest

8-15 Reps 
2-3 Minute Rest

10-12 Reps 

1-2 min Rest 

Low weight 

Squeeze the dumbbell hard in the middle of the handle and curl about 3/4 of the way up (i.e. stay in the bottom 3/4 of the curl).

12-15 Reps 
1-2 min Rest 
Long lengthened partials on last set 

Lean forward to get a big stretch on the lats at the top of the ROM and then stand upright as you squeeze your lats at the bottom.

10-12 Reps
1-2 Min Rest
MYO Reps Last Set 
Raise the cables up and out in a "Y" motion. Really try to connect with the middle delt fibers as you sweep the weight up and out.

8-10 Reps
2-3 Min Rest 
Pec Static Stretch (30 sec hold)

Set the bench at a ~15° incline. 1 second pause on the chest on each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs.

12-15 Reps
2 Min 
On all sets, alternate full-ROM reps and half-ROM reps (i.e. do 1 rep with full-ROM, then 1 rep half-ROM (in the stretched/bottom half), then 1 rep full-ROM, then 1 rep half-ROM).

Dropset 
8 Reps 
1-2 Min
Feel a nasty stretch on the triceps throughout the entire negative. Pause for 1 second in the stretch part of each rep.

Dropset
8 Reps
1-2 Min 
These are meant to be fairly heavy, which is why we're using a bar instead of a rope. Aim to add some weight week to week at the set rep target. Always keep the form tight

10-12 Reps 
1-2 Min Rest 
Round your lower back as you crunch. Maintain a mind-muscle connection with your 6-pack.

8-10 Reps
2-3 Min Rest 
Lean forward over the machine to get a maximum stretch in your hamstrings.

10-12 Reps
1-2 Min Rest 
Mind-muscle connection with your inner thighs. These are great for adding thigh mass from the front! Push them hard!

4, 6, 8 Reps 
3-5 Min rest 
We're using a reverse pyramid on this exercise. Warm-up as usual to your first working set for 4 reps. This first set will be your heaviest set.for set 2, drop the weight

Long-length Partials (on all reps of the last set)
10-12 reps 
1-2 Minutes 
Set the seat back as far as it will go while still feeling comfortable.Use a 2-3 sec negative,Feel your quads pulling apart

Calf Static Stretch(30 sec)
12-15 Reps 
1-2 Min 
1-2 sec pause at the bottom of each rep. Instead of just going up onto your toes, think about rolling your ankle back and forth on the balls on feet

8-12 Reps 
1-2 Min Rest

10-12 Reps 
2-3 Minutes Rest

1-2 min Rest

10-12 Reps 
1-2 Min Rest

10 Reps 
1-2 min Rest 
Feel a deep stretch on your triceps at the bottom. Avoid pausing at the top of each rep.

12-15 Reps

last set Drop set

Mechanical Dropset all sets
5,4,3+ Reps 
1-2 Min Rest 
Take 3 big steps back machine and do your first 5 reps. After those first 5 reps immediately without resting take 1 step forward and do another 4

10-12 Reps 
1-2 Min Rest 
Using a double overhand grip, perform rows while leaning forward on the negative and then extend your torso to be upright as you finish the row.

8-10 Reps 
2-3 Min Rest

10-12 Reps 
2-3 Min Rest 
Start the pulldown with a straight up posture. As you pull the bar down, lean back by about 15-30° to get the mid-back more involved touch the bar to your chest on all Reps

10-20 Reps 
2-3 in Rest 
Keep your arms extended out at 45° as you do back extensions. You should feel a crazy burn in your mid-back and lower back.

10-12 Reps
1-2 Min Rest 
Do a hammer curl on the positive, then turn your palms facing up at the top and use a palms-up grip on the negative.

10-12 Reps
1-2 Min Rest 
Shrug up and in.Think about shrugging up to your ears.1-2 second pause in the squeeze (at the top)of each rep, then another 1-2 second pause in the stretch the bottom all reps

10-12 Reps
2-3 Min Rest
Think about "drawing a sword" as you do the positive. Sweep your arm up, out and across your body.

10-12 Reps 
1-2 Min Rest 
Ensure that your elbows break at least 90°. Mind-muscle connection with your delts. Smooth, controlled reps.

8-10 Reps
2-3 Min Rest 
Pec Static Stretch (30 sec hold)

Set the bench at a ~15° incline. 1 second pause on the chest on each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs.

Slow 2-3 second negative8-10 Reps 
2-3 Min Rest
1-2 second pause at the bottom. Explode with control on the way up. Go as deep as your shoulders comfortably allow, trying to at least break a 90° elbow

Start LOW-TO-HIGH and then HIGH-TO-LOW 
15-20 Reps
2-3 Min Reps

10-12 Reps
2-3 Min Rest
Flare your elbows out at about 45° and keep your elbows locked in place as you complete the extensions.

10-20 Reps
1-2 Min Rest
Don't just bend at your hips, use your abs to lower yourself down under control and pull yourself back up.

8-12 Reps 
2-3 Min Rest
Long-length Partials (on all reps of the last set)

Set the machine so that you get the biggest stretch possible at the bottom. Prevent your butt from popping up as you curl.

8 Reps
3 Min Rest 
Feet lower on the platform for more quad focus. Get as deep as you can without excessive back rounding. Control the negative and do a slight pause at the bottom of each rep.

8 reps 
2-3 Min Rest 
2 sets each leg. Minimize contribution from the back leg. Mind-muscle connection with your glutes here!

10-12 Reps 
2 Min Rest 
Mind-muscle connection with your inner thighs. These are great for adding thigh mass from the front! Push them hard!

10-12 Reps 
1-2 Min Rest 
Allow yourself to come up onto your toes and push your knees forward past your toes. This is safe for the knees.

10-12 Reps 
2 Min Rest 
Calf Static Stretch (30 sec hold)

8-12 Reps 
1-2 Min Rest

10-12 Reps
1-2 min Rest 
Pause for 1-2 seconds in the squeeze of each rep. Contract the rear delts hard!

10-12 Reps 
1-2 min Rest 
Allow the cable to move back behind your head for maximum stretch on the triceps. Reach full extension with your elbows still around eye level at the top.
